model_annotation: The bar chart is designed to compare the effect size of different classifiers (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) across various types of Indo-European (IE) languages, along with an isolate language group. The horizontal axis lists the language families or language types, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-others, ISOulate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the effect size, measured numerically from 0 to 35, without explicitly stated units. Each classifier is represented by bars in different colors, with mBERT-L2 in blue, XLM-L2 in red, mBERT-R2 in green, XLM-R2 in purple, mBERT-B2 in dark blue, and XLM-B2 in light blue. The bars vary in height, indicating the effect size of each classifier for each language type, with error bars denoting variability. Some bars clearly reach the maximum effect size of 35, particularly in the Uralic category, while others are closer to the minimum effect size of 0, especially in the IE-Romance and IE-Slavic categories. The chart does not include any emphasis on specific bars or any sorting of the bars, and there are no additional annotations.
